llm.summary: The payment/order flow is mostly disclosed, but the post-payment service code is inconsistent with the advertised software copyright review and appears unable to deliver the stated service.

dimensions.detail: Network access, order-file read/write, and payment credential handling are proportionate to a paid service, but the service code also references an unrelated external data fetch after payment and lacks the referenced implementation files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time execution, package-install commands, shell persistence, or startup hooks were found in the inspected artifact files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: User-facing instructions disclose the three-stage paid order flow, clawtip payment, local order file, and transmission of question text and payCredential to api.ideaidea.com.cn. The undeclared post-payment analysis path is the main scope problem.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to order metadata under ~/.openclaw/skills/orders/{indicator}/{order_no}.json, which is disclosed and path-validated. It reads payCredential from that file and sends it to the payment backend as disclosed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill advertises a Chinese software copyright self-assessment, but service.py runs a 'SoftIP Self-Check' flow that references missing fetch_ssq.py and analyze_ssq.py scripts and says it fetches data from cwl.gov.cn, which is not disclosed in SKILL.md and does not fit the stated review purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. The order creation and payment credential flow are plainly described, but the paid fulfillment script does not match the advertised copyright review and appears broken because required analysis scripts are absent. Do not rely on this skill for a paid assessment unless the publisher explains and fixes the post-payment service implementation.
